coordinate_contract.phone: Back-view u=0.5-x/width; v=0.5-y/height. Source stylization uses body width for camera x AND y. Assignment compares source (x-x0,y-y0)/source_width with profile (width/2-x,height/2-y)/width.
coordinate_contract.landscape_tablet: Use existing 90deg 0deg 90deg orientation, then world part bounds. Back-view u=0.5+y/height; v=0.5-x/width; source camera y is scaled by source width, so comparison uses (u,v*width/height).
coordinate_contract.portrait_tablet: Back-view u=0.5-x/width; v=0.5-y/height; same width-scaled source comparison as phones.
coordinate_contract.indices: Minimum squared-distance bijection of measured source optical feature centers to actual profile camera.windows plus rear sensors; never use source lens ordinal as profile window index.
